text: 商务部新闻发言人黄玲在5日举行的例行新闻发布会上回答有关进口美国农产品的提问时表示，中美农产品贸易是双边经贸合作的重要组成部分。扩大两国在农业领域合作，既可以丰富两国民众的餐桌，也能给两国企业和农民提供稳定的经济收入，为双方带来实实在在的好处。中方一直对扩大自美采购农产品持开放态度，但前提是双方达成的“300亿对300亿”对等降税安排落地。希望美方与中方共同努力，通过共同降低关税、减少非关税壁垒、扩大市场准入等方式，为两国农产品贸易创造更多有利条件。（新华社）
text_en: Ministry of Commerce spokesperson Huang Ling, responding to a question about imports of US agricultural products at a regular press conference on the 5th, said China-US agricultural trade is an important part of bilateral economic and trade cooperation. Expanding cooperation in agriculture between the two countries can both enrich the dining tables of both peoples and provide stable economic income for companies and farmers in both countries, bringing tangible benefits to both sides. China has always been open to expanding purchases of US agricultural products, but the premise is that the mutually agreed "300 billion to 300 billion" reciprocal tariff reduction arrangement is implemented. China hopes the US side will work with China to create more favorable conditions for agricultural trade between the two countries by jointly reducing tariffs, cutting non-tariff barriers and expanding market access. (Xinhua)
